---
title: "Numbers"
---

# Numbers

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Numbers chronicles Israel's journey from Sinai to the edge of the Promised Land, highlighting both God's faithfulness and Israel's repeated struggles with unbelief. The central lesson is that God's promises are sure, but entering into them requires trust and obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Twenty years old and upward</div>

### Why This Verse

Defines the census purpose

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the census of Israel's fighting men. The key verse emphasizes God's organization of His people for service and responsibility.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 2:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Every man by his own standard</div>

### Why This Verse

Organization of Israel's camp

### Chapter Insight

This chapter arranges the tribes around the Tabernacle. The key verse highlights God's order and central presence among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 3:12</div>

<div class="identifier">I have taken the Levites</div>

### Why This Verse

Establishes Levitical service

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes the Levites' role in serving the Tabernacle. The key verse emphasizes substitution and dedication to God's service.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 4:15</div>

<div class="identifier">They shall not touch any holy thing</div>

### Why This Verse

Reverence for holy objects

### Chapter Insight

This chapter assigns specific duties to the Levitical families. The key verse demonstrates that every servant has a God-appointed responsibility.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 5:6</div>

<div class="identifier">When a man or woman commits a sin</div>

### Why This Verse

Confession and restitution principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses purity, restitution, and faithfulness within the camp. The key verse reflects God's concern for holiness among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 6:24</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD bless thee and keep thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Beginning of the Aaronic blessing

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the Nazirite vow and priestly blessing. The key verse expresses God's desire to bless and keep His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 7:89</div>

<div class="identifier">He heard the voice speaking unto him</div>

### Why This Verse

God's presence with Moses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the offerings of the tribal leaders. The key verse highlights worship through generous and unified giving.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 8:17</div>

<div class="identifier">All the firstborn are Mine</div>

### Why This Verse

Reason for Levite substitution

### Chapter Insight

This chapter consecrates the Levites for service. The key verse emphasizes purification and dedication for ministry.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 9:23</div>

<div class="identifier">At the commandment of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Guidance by divine command

### Chapter Insight

This chapter observes the Passover and God's guidance by the cloud. The key verse underscores following God's direction in every circumstance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 10:35</div>

<div class="identifier">Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous wilderness prayer

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's departure from Sinai. The key verse expresses dependence on God's presence in every journey.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 11:29</div>

<div class="identifier">Would God that all the LORD's people were prophets</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently cited prophetic ideal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Israel's complaints and God's provision of quail. The key verse reveals the danger of discontentment despite God's blessings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 12:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Moses was very meek</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic description of Moses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Miriam and Aaron's opposition to Moses. The key verse highlights Moses' humility and God's defense of His servant.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 13:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Let us go up at once and possess it</div>

### Why This Verse

Caleb's statement of faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the spies' exploration of Canaan. The key verse contrasts faith in God's promise with fear of circumstances.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 14:18</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD is longsuffering and of great mercy</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational description of God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's rebellion after the spies' report. The key verse demonstrates Caleb's wholehearted trust in God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 15:39</div>

<div class="identifier">Remember all the commandments</div>

### Why This Verse

Purpose of the tassels

### Chapter Insight

This chapter provides laws reminding Israel of covenant faithfulness. The key verse explains the purpose of the tassels as reminders to obey God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 16:48</div>

<div class="identifier">He stood between the dead and the living</div>

### Why This Verse

Powerful intercession image

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Korah's rebellion against God's appointed leadership. The key verse demonstrates God's vindication of His chosen servants.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 17:8</div>

<div class="identifier">Aaron's rod budded</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine confirmation of priesthood

### Chapter Insight

This chapter confirms Aaron's priesthood through the budding rod. The key verse serves as a sign of God's chosen authority.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 18:20</div>

<div class="identifier">I am thy part and thine inheritance</div>

### Why This Verse

Priestly inheritance theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter outlines priestly and Levitical responsibilities. The key verse emphasizes God's provision for those serving Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 19:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Water of separation</div>

### Why This Verse

Key red-heifer ordinance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes the ordinance of the red heifer. The key verse highlights God's provision for purification from defilement.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 20:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Because ye believed Me not</div>

### Why This Verse

Moses barred from entering Canaan

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Moses striking the rock and being disciplined. The key verse demonstrates the importance of honoring God through obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 21:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The bronze serpent</div>

### Why This Verse

Explicitly referenced by Jesus (John 3)

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts victories, judgments, and the bronze serpent. The key verse reveals God's provision of healing through faith.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 22:28</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey</div>

### Why This Verse

Most memorable verse of chapter

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces Balaam and Balak. The key verse shows God's sovereignty over human intentions.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 23:19</div>

<div class="identifier">God is not a man that He should lie</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted theological statement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Balaam's first prophecies concerning Israel. The key verse affirms that God's blessing cannot be reversed by man.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 24:17</div>

<div class="identifier">A star shall come out of Jacob</div>

### Why This Verse

Major messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Balaam's final prophecies. The key verse points to a future ruler arising from Israel.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 25:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Phinehas turned away My wrath</div>

### Why This Verse

Central covenant-zeal passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's sin with Moab and Midian. The key verse highlights zeal for God's holiness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 26:65</div>

<div class="identifier">Not a man remained</div>

### Why This Verse

Fulfillment of wilderness judgment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records a second census before entering Canaan. The key verse demonstrates God's faithfulness across generations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 27:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Take Joshua, a man in whom is the spirit</div>

### Why This Verse

Joshua's commissioning

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses inheritance and Joshua's appointment. The key verse shows God's provision for future leadership.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 28:2</div>

<div class="identifier">My offering, My bread</div>

### Why This Verse

Daily sacrifice emphasis

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reviews daily and seasonal offerings. The key verse emphasizes continual worship before God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 29:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Feast of Trumpets</div>

### Why This Verse

Key festival reference

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues instructions for Israel's annual feasts. The key verse highlights the importance of sacred worship rhythms.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 30:2</div>

<div class="identifier">He shall not break his word</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently cited vow principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter regulates vows and commitments. The key verse stresses personal accountability before God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 31:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Purified with fire and water</div>

### Why This Verse

Purification instruction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's victory over Midian. The key verse demonstrates God's justice and faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 32

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 32:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Be sure your sin will find you out</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the best-known verses in Numbers

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses the settlement of Reuben, Gad, and half-Manasseh. The key verse emphasizes fulfilling responsibilities before enjoying blessings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 33

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 33:55</div>

<div class="identifier">Thorns in your sides</div>

### Why This Verse

Warning against compromise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter reviews Israel's wilderness journey. The key verse encourages remembrance of God's guidance and faithfulness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 34

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 34:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Let us fall now into the hand of the LORD...</div>

### Why This Verse

Defines the boundaries of the Promised Land

### Chapter Insight

This chapter defines the boundaries of the Promised Land. The key verse establishes God's specific inheritance for His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 35

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 35:33</div>

<div class="identifier">Blood defileth the land</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundational principle of justice and atonement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes cities of refuge and principles of justice. The key verse underscores the seriousness of bloodshed and the need for atonement.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 36

<div class="key-verse">Numbers 36:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Preservation of tribal inheritance</div>

### Why This Verse

Preservation of tribal inheritance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter preserves tribal inheritance through marriage regulations. The key verse protects God's allotment of land among the tribes of Israel.
:::
